description: This source file contains the implementation of a remote dispatcher for the OFBiz service framework, specifically providing remote access to service invocation methods over RMI. It defines the class RemoteDispatcherImpl which extends UnicastRemoteObject and implements the RemoteDispatcher interface, wrapping a LocalDispatcher instance and adding remote invocation capabilities with additional export control logic.
